checks.detail: After setup, restore pre-do_sample common state using correct zero-argument capture callback. checks.name: Prescribed geometry and saving
checks.detail: Old/new raw optical FP32 and K, H and both FOV masks plus actual new conditioning descriptors are saved before model load/generation. Latents are saved on sampler return before decode; raw target FP32 before original quantization; exceptions retain available artifacts.

checks.name: Both score strata and unknown precedence
checks.detail: Scorer pins actual successful external/worker receipts and array bodies, fixed prescribed geometry, original emitted uint8. Same mutual descriptor matches supply identity/H paired residuals; all-valid and common-FOV outcomes include counts/coverage/N and Nc fractions. Four target IDs enforced; any undefined median gives None before all(). No fits or residual-driven filtering.

checks.name: Observer integration
checks.detail: Root binding SHA and each supplied reviewed-file SHA checked before launch; lexical venv argv exact. Frozen3540s worker/3600s external, 0.5s sampled tree RSS45GiB and disk10GiB. Child uses its own process group; detected limits/errors invoke group kill and wait. append_event signature compatible. No installation or test execution by this source review.

limitations: Source PASS is not actual loading, generation, RNG recovery, numerical/H verification, external process cleanup observation or scientific success. Root must bind all six required final source/protocol files plus this review in its existing binding; observer iterates that supplied map rather than enforcing a separate mandatory-map schema.

Nonintervened tensor guards use torch.equal after finite/shape checks: exact numerical equality, not a sign-zero-sensitive byte test. Saved descriptors permit the subsequent independent result review to verify byte-equality wording; source PASS does not claim those actual values have passed.
RNG state equality is under the pinned original draw path; per-step epsilon bodies were never archived by A0, so no direct epsilon-byte comparison claim.

Successful new-process model checks cover actual parameter/buffer value/mode and local identities; on failed run a complete final model check/terminal RNG may be absent. FAILED status and partial evidence remain; such a run cannot pass scorer comparability.

RSS is sampled, not an instantaneous memory cap. Observer cleanup is the bounded direct-child process-group path; source review does not certify live descendant disappearance or arbitrary detached processes. Original reviewed computation does not intentionally launch detached jobs.
Scorer is intended after actual terminal review and requires root external60s timeout per protocol; its internal55s checks are boundary checks, not interrupting a long native call.

Generator advisory maps_minus1_plus1 uses Torch comparison and inherits the disclosed S70 boundary at rawFP32(-0.1). Actual images use original tensor_to_pil; do not treat the advisory boolean as authoritative quantization evidence.

Same scene and one fixed image-grid random realization, four coupled target views. Common FOV/matched samples are conditional and may contain false matches. Positive direction is not exact H-noise equivariance, camera calibration, isolated ray causality, novel method, or resolution of S73 UNKNOWN.
